sources.ref: Moondrop Custom EQ web app 1.8.0 build 26B1107 (https://hub.moondroplab.com/), bundle assets/index-iHwVcdAT.js: device table, BLUE ROSE config; chunks assets/DacFilterType-D-41tuim.js, DacMode-E9SgAdjr.js, LedControl-eBproyea.js, MicGainOffset-CVAKm01u.js, dac-BTHrpc0M.js

meta.notes: The app lists it under the brand ddHiFi and does not switch slots on it (its custom EQ is slot 0); it has no built-in presets. Its controller panel has the DAC's filter, the DAC output mode and the LED, listed here with the app's names; the app writes each without saving, so whether one outlasts a replug is unconfirmed, and which of them it shows is decided by Moondrop's server per firmware. Global Gain is the main family's, repeated here because a profile's control list replaces its base's. Not listed: Microphone Gain, two steps (Low Gain, High Gain) that the app writes and saves but never reads back, keeping its own record of the choice, and a factory reset. Its USB product name is unknown, so only the ids match.
